calculation.description: For each tradable asset, reverse its market-residual daily return, with modest strengthening when the tradable US10Y/CN10Y log spread has experienced an extreme five-session move. All inputs are lagged/current-day completed data and the signal is used cross-sectionally. US10Y and CN10Y are tradable benchmark entries; observation-only macro series are not ordered.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (+0.060465, 592 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.057006, 410 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.027525, 491 dates). Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation. High turnover warrants rebalance-cost monitoring.
